item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary must move to establish an internal FAA organization, while the Administrator determines its components and may delegate operational responsibilities; these are present organizational and management directions, not changes to external legal rights.","evidence":"The Secretary of Transportation (Secretary) shall, consistent with his legal authorities, move to establish within the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) a performancebased organization"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The COO is assigned an internal leadership and reporting role and must later negotiate a performance agreement; the possible bonus remains contingent on a future performance evaluation rather than being presently awarded or mandated.","evidence":"The COO, in consultation with the Air Traffic Control Subcommittee of the Aviation Management Advisory Committee, shall enter into an annual performance agreement with the Administrator"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The COO and ATO are directed to plan, coordinate, consult, operate, develop agreements and methods, create managerial incentives, and recommend changes; these are internal management and discretionary implementation activities without a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"The COO shall develop a 5-year strategic plan for the air traffic control system"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Air Traffic Control Subcommittee must provide ongoing internal oversight of the ATO's administration and operations, an executive-management function rather than a substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"shall provide, consistent with its responsibilities under Air-21, general oversight to ATO"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The Committee must submit an internal evaluative report within five years; the accompanying definition and judicial-review disclaimer do not themselves impose a substantive legal consequence or direct a later one.","evidence":"shall provide to the Secretary and the Administrator a report on the operation and effectiveness of the ATO"}]}
